name: writing-for-humans
description: The house standard for writing that a human can follow and that reads like a person wrote it. Two axes: readability (concise means simplify not compress, discursive sentences over telegraphic fragments, show-don't-name with worked examples, format by the shape of the information) and voice (the eight tells that mark text as machine-written, plus the author's own measured written register). Apply to any human-facing writing: proposals, PRs, docs, issues, messages.
